card.what: Stainless strap gudgeon for a transom-hung rudder: a 25 x 5 mm strap wrapped round a bushed eye for a 1/2 in pin, its legs bent flat onto the transom and bolted through
card.boats: J/22 (two per pintle, one above and one below it, 50 mm offset: kit option offset=0.05); Hobie 16 transoms (build_fleet, default 26 mm offset); dressed J/22 layout (GudgeonUpper/Lower)
card.distance: arm's reach from the cockpit, looking aft over the transom
card.before: kit Gudgeon from bk_parts.gudgeon (Oct 2026): a plain cylinder eye between two flat straps running into the hull

references.use: the look: Bean's J/22 photos tiller-transom-attachemnt and -2 (Rush Creek, Oct 2026), as already built into the hero J/22 (Inputs/j22-hero/j22_steering.py); private, never in the repo
